text:
Zoe (Support): FYI - incoming customer request from EdgeApps asking to onboard 'OpenFan-3.2' and pin it to EU + APAC. They need deterministic routing and version pinning for compliance. They mentioned quantized variant too.
Nate (Sales): +1, this is from a pilot account (edgeapps-prod). They want EU primary, APAC DR, and fallback to hosted-us only if capacity exhausted. Also requested SLA 99.9 for inference latency.
Priya (PM): Need details: which model files, expected qps, token distribution, and whether they require private (VPC) vs Hosted. Zoe can you paste the request copy?
Zoe (Support): Copy of customer ask pasted below:
> "We'd like OpenFan-3.2 onboarded and pinned to eu-west-1 + ap-southeast-1. Version pin required (3.2.1 specific). Prefer int8 quantized build for cost. Expected steady qps 60, spikes to 250 for 10-15m windows. Latency SLO 150ms p95. Can you scope Dedicated vs Hosted?"
Miguel (SRE): 150ms p95 on quantized 3.2 at 250 spike QPS is ambitious. We need model perf profile and KV cache hit assumptions. Also region capacity check for ap-southeast-1 on our dedicated pools.
Priya (PM): Action: ask customer for sample payloads + percentiles (seq_len distribution). Also confirm whether they need private tenancy or ok with Hosted with isolation via Dedicated.
Nate (Sales): They said pilot wants hosted first, then Dedicated later. But legal requires version pin & audit logs. Likely will convert to Dedicated once pilot proves out.
Zoe (Support): Customer provided example prompt and average tokens ~180, max ~1200. I'll forward.
Miguel (SRE): For now estimate cost+capacity: steadystate 60 qps * 180 tokens = ~10800 tokens/s. With batching we might be okay on a small dedicated shard but spikes to 250 require burst policy or autoscale. Need to flag to infra for capacity reservation in eu-west-1 + ap-southeast-1.
Priya (PM): Prioritization: classify as "customer pilot -> medium". Requirements for product backlog item: onboarding checklist entry, model artifact link, quantization recipe, perf benchmark target, geo-pin policy, version pinning metadata, rollout policy (canary + auto-fallback to hosted-us).
OnboardBot: New intake created: onboarding-ticket-3821. Please attach model tarball URL and testset.
Nate (Sales): I'll push for pilot start next week, but only if we can guarantee version pin and audit logs. Any blockers on the audit side?
Miguel (SRE): Audit logs are fine for Hosted; Dedicated gives more control. We must ensure KeyManager integration for customer keys if they request CMK. Put that in the ticket.
Priya (PM): Next steps: (1) Zoe to collect sample payloads + model artifacts (2) Nate to confirm pilot cadence and legal pin requirements (3) Miguel to run perf estimate + capacity check and update onboarding-ticket-3821.
Zoe (Support): Got it. Sending artifacts now. :thumbsup:
Miguel (SRE): I'll run a quick perf sim with existing OpenFan-3.x profiles, will update by EOD.
Priya (PM): If perf looks ok, I'll draft an acceptance checklist for product backlog: onboarding, compliance signoff, geo-pin config, canary plan, observability dashboards, rollback criteria.
Nate (Sales): Anything we should add to SLA doc for pilot? They asked 99.9 latency SLO and audit trail. Might be better to offer 99.5 for hosted pilot, escalate to 99.9 for Dedicated.
Priya (PM): Good point. Add SLA gradation to ticket.
Zoe (Support): Ticket updated with artifacts + customer note.
OnboardBot: onboarding-ticket-3821 updated: attachments added (payload_examples.json, model_manifest.yaml).
Priya (PM): I'll convert ticket into a GH backlog item if Miguel's perf is green. Thanks everyone.
